select bmc.cid ,bmc.api_code ,bmc.name, bmc.short_name from b_marketing_customer bmc where bmc.status=1 and
ISNULL(bmc.cid) = 0
bmc.cid=#{cid}

select id,cid,api_code,name,short_name from b_marketing_customer bmc where bmc.status = 1
and bmc.short_name like concat("%", #{value},"%") or bmc.api_code like concat("%", #{value},"%")
order by bmc.id desc

select id, cid, message, sort, status , api_code as apiCode , thread_num as threadNum , extend_config_info as extendConfigInfo , push_type as pushType , push_thread_num as pushThreadNum , push_url as pushUrl , name , short_name as shortName , DATE_FORMAT(mc.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime , DATE_FORMAT(mc.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from b_marketing_customer mc
status = 1
and mc.cid like CONCAT('%',#{cid},'%')
and mc.api_code like CONCAT('%',#{apiCode},'%')
order by mc.update_time desc, mc.create_time desc
